integrity: Finite-parameter and critical-window statements have analytic proofs; numerical checks are supporting evidence, not proof of infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Only circular complex Gaussian coefficients and power-variance weights with exponent alpha >= 0.
Only mean and variance, not distributional convergence or concentration bounds.
Historical priority under alternative Jensen-statistic terminology is not completely settled.
title: Two critical variance scales for power-weighted Gaussian Mahler means
